result.title: Sample Clause Finder
result.summary: Finds the clauses that Example Rule 900.12 says a made-up contract must carry.

provenance.note: Built from the public text of Example Rule 900.12 as published at rules.example. Written from scratch: no code, text or design was copied from another project.

retirement.note: Example Rule 900.44 was repealed, and Example Form 12 with it. The entry is kept for the record.
